title: Bind all 7,548 G20 route markers to conditional ROW cover words
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This binds every actual G20 internal route marker to a frozen concrete normalizer word under an explicit **single-ROW-cover model**. The exact PR #5798 stream has **7,548 markers**, with 3,774 ENTRY and RETURN records each. Every retained event index is joined to its source call, thick-stage ordinal, owner bank, port, phase and word hash.

PR #5798 already checks the complete global endpoint, marker placements and original fee; PR #5801 already constructs the 111 RIGHT normalizer/inverse words. The new result closes their stated incidence/direction gap without claiming either predecessor construction. Markers themselves do not encode a physical lowering. Under the retained convention h=gS and local P=WQW^-1, ENTRY uses inverse_word and RETURN forward_word, returning borrowed g exactly.

The source native pairing is x_i with x_(15-i). Applying W on both paired halves means physical diag(W,JWJ), not contiguous diag(W,W). An independent oracle checks **222 word products, 111 cover conjugations, 1,776 literal paired basis columns and all18 chosen layouts**. Actual source ports discriminate wrong direction, missing second half and wrong reflection. Two more controls preserve aggregate counts while breaking actual bank restoration.

The selected words contain **202,640 ADDs and 73,916 SCALEs**. Conditional lifting to every N=127f cover row/lane gives **25,735,280 ordered_shift and 9,387,332 unit_scale calls times f^2**. One cover word per owner-marker already affects both native halves through the encoding; there is no second full ROW-word factor for those halves. Each coefficient keeps its own positive symbolic tariff. These are counts for this declared plan, not a canonical full invoice or unit prices.

Literal physical head-map correspondence, cache COPY/CLEAR, carries, low-type commit, padding, movement, restoration schedule, coefficient preparation/tariffs, compiler and supplier admission remain open. Native/global theorems remain dependencies; the five inherited framework assumptions remain. No new kappa or frontier change.

## Task selection and overlap

Canonical main refreshed: de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a, priority8. Source #5798: eaa9cc8c15d8e994d7b81b0cda3f6dd63b0db826. Word source #5801: eb92cbdf211f0c3717ff6fa71af47ec38f8e412d.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5777#discussioncomment-19205398) and TASK.json explicitly narrow the formal-interface-lemma card to this particular binding audit, with no Lean build or physical implementation expansion. Live intake covered356 open PR records, actual #5777/#1166 handoffs and a focused G20 Discussion search. Sparse local inventory, Discussion search and unpublished work remain coverage limits; no-match is not novelty proof.

Exactly15 files are added in research/g20-route-word-binding. Frozen source data are authenticated by raw SHA256/Git blob pins, without predecessor implementation or cross-checker imports. Main-context ancestry and input-origin byte bindings are separate.

## Validation

Python3.12.14, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-route-word-binding
```

Registered normal/optimized primary and separate optimized oracle pass. Their complete event-join hashes and every coefficient count agree. Seven primary controls rebuild the altered bill before semantic rejection where applicable; the oracle adds five actual algebra/owner/restoration controls. Complete canonical receipts preserve numeric-type distinctions.

Committed bytes/modes/declared main history and official export checks pass. A read-only Git-free isolated optimized replay with empty PATH passes both checkers in about3.53 seconds, preserving all16 exported files including the integrity manifest. Export SHA256: e7ed8b63dd3f890ff0216d66e5fcbb403f0d73093e5203625ba6553c8bed5a6e. Current selected baseline passes bindings/metadata only.

Publication head b895ae7770a97276ae0e9c13fb0c51cbed4fd00a; tree84f7450f477c985e5bd2571bf74181d1b254b682. Hosted checks not yet observed; no hosted scientific pass is claimed. The shared assignment-suite repair remains #5761.

## Credit and next obligation

Ali Romman with Codex assistance supplied the G20 construction/audits and normalizer witnesses. Retain Dugongue, ai-nanachi, #5679/#5708/#5782 and all source lineage. JoyboyBrian supplied the earlier ROW/P2 schedule and its retained predecessors. ToikY/Codex #5801 words are frozen predecessor work. New marker-to-word binding, conditional cover convention and reflected-address audit: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, separate primary/oracle/proof-review contexts. Classical conjugation is not a new general theorem. Apache-2.0; NOTICE retains attribution.

Next: bind one actual marker to the literal physical ROW head/cache/carry/commit/padding/return implementation and prove coefficient-specific tariffs before importing this plan into a full caller invoice. Independent acceptance remains. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or closure requested.
